explanation: Rechecking gives ∂Q/∂x−∂P/∂y=−x²−y². The formal area integral is −2π∫₂⁴r³dr=−120π, matching option a; it also equals the convergent improper boundary integral. The earlier uncertainty remains because ln(sin²y) is undefined at y=0 and y=±π on the boundary, so the ordinary line integral and standard Green's theorem hypotheses fail as stated.
